assets.name: Ecliptic Express — voiture de voyageurs
assets.prompt: Create exactly one wide 2:1 horizontal fighting-game background master for Resident Evil Combat: the Ecliptic Express passenger carriage from Resident Evil Zero HD Remaster (2016), guided by both attached gameplay screenshots. Use the same rich dark wood interior, narrow low curved carriage ceiling, brass fittings and luggage rails, patterned cream-and-dark upholstered seats, tall rectangular windows with dark night forest outside, inset decorative wall panels and warm ceiling lamps. Preserve its worn and oppressive old luxury train identity. Build a lateral side view looking across the carriage at the long window wall, with a shallow coherent perspective. Arrange the original-style passenger seats and small travel cases behind the playing plane, leaving one uninterrupted level dark wood/carpet combat strip across the lower quarter. The lateral width and open strip are a deliberate combat adaptation, not a geometric replica. Keep the train enclosed and low; no station, restaurant hall, locomotive exterior or modern subway. Remove every person, zombie, dog, body, blood spray, weapon and UI from the references. Detailed semi-realistic painted game environment with restrained warm interior lighting and dark cool windows. One scene only, no panels, map, text, labels, watermark or logo. Opaque background, full frame.
review: Boiseries, luminaires et assises à motifs repris; sièges redisposés derrière une piste horizontale. Aucun personnage ni HUD.
Nouvelle composition latérale adaptée, sans certification géométrique 1:1.
PNG opaque unique; aucune couche de parallaxe séparée ni animation.

assets.name: Centre de détention — coursive des cellules
assets.prompt: Create exactly one wide 2:1 horizontal fighting-game background master for Resident Evil Combat, based on the attached actual Resident Evil Revelations 2 Episode 1 (2015) PlayStation 4 screenshot of the detention center cell block. Translate this specific dilapidated prison walkway into a lateral fighting stage: peeling off-white plaster over dull blue-green lower walls, crumbling masonry, rusted thin metal posts and bars, closed dark cell doors with small red lamps, battered greenish railings and exposed mesh, dim caged wall lights, a high shadowed barred window and cold teal light deeper in the cell block. Use the screenshot's corroded surfaces, severe vertical structure and claustrophobic proportions. Place a continuous level metal-and-concrete walkway across the lower quarter as an unobstructed fighting strip; railings, cell doors and support posts remain behind it. Almost straight-on side view, shallow coherent depth, architecture adapted laterally rather than an exact reconstruction. Remove Barry, Natalia, all monsters, bodies, weapons, muzzle flashes, map, HUD, numbers and any first-person objects. No outside watchtower or invented courtyard: this is the interior cell-block walkway. Semi-realistic detailed game environment painting, dark teal-grey and dirty cream, restrained warm wall lamps. One continuous opaque scene, no split panels, no labels, text, logo or watermark.

assets.name: Lanshiang — rue commerçante nocturne
assets.prompt: Create exactly one wide 2:1 horizontal fighting-game background master for Resident Evil Combat, adapting the actual Resident Evil 6 (2012) Jake Chapter 4 Lanshiang night-street screenshot supplied. Preserve the observed densely stacked old urban storefronts: stained brown-grey concrete facades, shut ribbed shop shutters, thin metal awnings, exposed pipes and cables, small box air conditioners, narrow balconies and fire-escape structures, the distinctive vertical metal ladder under an orange-red illuminated shop sign. Keep the same dark cramped Chinese commercial-street atmosphere with warm amber-red neon accents and deep night shadows, not a futuristic cyberpunk city. Recompose as a near straight-on lateral view of the storefront frontage, with one clear level asphalt combat strip spanning the lower quarter. Move tall street clutter behind that strip; use shallow believable perspective. Source lettering is too small to resolve: keep sign shapes and indistinct light marks without inventing readable branding. Remove the character, all people/monsters, the bright pink annotation boxes, objective marker, HUD, distance text and weapons. No helicopter, fireball or new landmarks. Detailed semi-realistic environment painting, one continuous opaque scene, no collage, no map, no labels, captions, logos or watermark. This is a source-guided lateral adaptation, not a certified 1:1 reconstruction.
review: Façades, rideaux métalliques, climatiseurs, échelle et enseigne orange repris. Signalétique réinterprétée sans identification textuelle; détail fin de source limité par sa résolution.
